sourceMethods: All 128 active subnet slots and SubnetRadar profiles; current identities checked, including SN76 deregistration and reuse.
100 dated September 5–6 SubnetRadar briefs, including the ecosystem channel; relative dates checked against source-message timestamps where material.
150 repository paths checked through 10:44 AM ET, with paginated commit retrieval; 145 accessible. Includes legacy mappings, two additional research candidates and core Subtensor.

128 indexed X queries by current name, SN number and available account aliases; 66 public account pages read and refreshed, yielding 76 unique current original posts across the feed and account samples.
Signed-in AlphaGap feed reviewed for development, social and market leads; original code and posts used to correct stale or contradictory summaries.

TAO Daily, TAO Media, public news feeds and outside partner searches; Stonk and Sunrise confirmations, both user-supplied X links, Ditto announcements, Actual sponsor confirmation and selected primary repositories.
Shizzy Unchained YouTube Videos and Live tabs checked and refreshed. Latest upload and stream IDs, titles and durations still match the site; no newer item found.
Chain-derived rolling 24-hour α/TAO market snapshot checked. Price is context for material news, not the sole reason for its rating. Coverage ends 10:44 AM ET.
accessGaps: Authenticated X search redirected to login; Grok and complete signed-in timelines were unavailable. Public account pages expose limited recent samples, and indexed queries did not surface relevant current posts. This is not exhaustive X coverage.

Private Discord history was not opened. Dated AI-generated briefs are secondary sources; uncorroborated operating reports, counts and roadmap claims remain developing. AlphaGap’s feed covers 48 hours and can repeat earlier news or misstate units and rollout status.

Stonk and Sunrise confirm the announcement, but the launch page returned empty quote-token categories in this browser session. No wallet was connected or launch transaction tested. Sammy’s liquidity thesis and rumored subnet-alpha pairs are not verified outcomes.

Phylax deregistration is recorded by SubnetRadar and the current slot identity has reset. The claimed MicroTensor continuation was not independently corroborated. The new SN76 pool’s apparent 24-hour price change is excluded as a misleading comparison across registrations.

Five mapped repository paths returned 404: deprecated/deprecated, actual-computer/actual-subnet-95, Satori119/Satori, NIOME-BITTENSOR/NIOME and Oh-My-Ditto/ditto. Alternate candidates were checked where available; capabilityforge/cf-subnet was not confirmed as the new SN119 learning platform.

TAO.com’s current fee-clarification post was found, but its linked X article was unavailable. No fee numbers were invented. KubeTEE’s cumulative recycling dollar total was not independently reconciled.
Earlier announcements are not republished as fresh launches. No independently verified forward alpha-unlock calendar was available. Later announcements belong to the next coverage window.

excluded.reason: Deregistered pool replaced; cross-registration return is invalid.

editorialDecisions.decision: Lead is the confirmed TAO pairing announcement from both Stonk and Sunrise. Both supplied URLs included. Price causality, $0.11 premium and future alpha pairs are not asserted as verified.
Five-star deregistration. Name new slot separately; omit +229% reset-derived price. Do not publish an unverified move to MicroTensor as fact. Legacy Phylax README still says live and is stale.

Five-star merged economic overhaul. Primary diff removes champion decay, contrary to AlphaGap summary; distinguish code merge from network activation. Do not assert an independently measured fourfold payout increase.
50% of profit after costs, not revenue; no measured buyback total. Announced 1,342+ integrations and V2 waitlist both stated.
PR625 is open and unmerged at final check; author-reported burn counts are not independently reproduced.
September 5 source messages make tomorrow September 6, not September 7. Public latest release still v4.9.8; no invented delay or activation.
OpenGPU integration dates to June; current brief is clarification, not a fresh launch. September 1 research story already covered September 5. No duplicate launch card.
Contribution artifacts are not proof of three solved open problems. Erdős357 source explicitly disclaims full solution.
Endpoint pilot is component interoperability only, public calibration and weights inactive per primary README.
August23 mechanism predates this window; current dashboard follow-up clearly identified. Avoid erroneous 11-day interval and independently unverified cumulative USD accounting.
Organizer and founder both confirm sponsorship, no commercial value inferred.
Emission restart awaits approval, not confirmed resumed.
Do not recycle a September5 relative start time into a September6 deadline.
New learning platform is a secondary-source lead. Same-name GitHub candidate describes capability packs, so identity is unconfirmed and it is not used as release proof.
Ecosystem brief reviewed; channel number is not an active subnet.
Exclude TAO.com unavailable fee article detail, satirical BD post, generic price forecasts, unverified wallet/fraud allegations and meme buy recommendations.
Videos and Live refreshed, both latest IDs unchanged. Do not manufacture a new video update. Prior dated reports unchanged.
